_comment: ag3s-verifier 산출. 해석을 쓰지 않는다 — 숫자와 경로만.

runs.command: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work .venv-ag3s/bin/python -u -m benchmark.trajopt.experiments.esdf_rollout --records outputs/live_test/20260925_headfix16d/records/run_0000/run_0000 --attention benchmark/ag3s/asset/data/attention_16d_headfix.npz --frames 15 --voxel 0.020 --esdf-margin 0.05 --cameras all --support-surfaces field --constraint-links arms --out-json outputs/verify/X3/headfix_rollout.json

numbers._comment: 로그와 논문에 쓰이는 모든 수치가 여기에만 있다.

measurement_1_reproduction.note: 로그 재촬영 표와 개수가 전부 같다. clearance 중앙/최소는 mm 단위로 흔들렸다 (기준선은 개수만 센다)

measurement_2_notes.note_text: the trajectory clears every constraint, but AG3S could not certify the geometry behind them; safety cannot be claimed for a scene that was not fully accounted for
